I moved left to (9,5). So the map is accurate: x=12 is a wall column (the '#' at the right edge). Wait — the map shows row 5 as `#..........@#` — the '@' is at x=11 and '#' at x=12. So x=12 IS a wall. The '.' I saw earlier at x=12 in the zoomed view was actually... let me recheck. In the zoomed map, columns were x 7..12, and row 3 was `####.#` meaning x=11 is '.', x=12 is '#'. So x=12 is always a wall.

So the only route to the top area (y=1,2) is through the gap at (11,3). The rockslide at (11,4) blocks the column. Let me check: is there any other opening? Row 3 is `###########.#` — only x=11 is open in row 3. So the top region connects to the bottom ONLY via (11,3)-(11,4). And (11,4) is the rockslide.

So the shrine is genuinely unreachable until the rockslide is cleared on day 5 morning. Let me verify by checking the rockslide.
